valid.code: function isInstanceOf<Instance>(value: unknown, ctor: Function & { readonly 'prototype': Instance }): value is Instance { return value instanceof ctor; } class MyClass {} declare const existing: unknown; if (isInstanceOf(existing, MyClass)) {}
valid.name: an inferred type argument resolved to a non-generic class with no `any` is valid

valid.code: function isString<T>(value: T): value is string & T { return typeof value === 'string'; } declare const input: number; if (isString(input)) {}
valid.name: a guard whose predicate is fully determined by its own parameter's type is valid

valid.code: function areInstancesOf<T>(value: unknown, other: unknown, ctor: new (...args: unknown[]) => T): value is T { return value instanceof ctor && other instanceof ctor; }
valid.name: a predicate derived from a parameter's own construct-signature return type is valid
